sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can concede points gracefully using bár... mégis and jóllehet.
I can attach a condition to my agreement with amennyiben, or name a reservation with fenntartás.
I can say what árnyalás, kivétel and fenntartás mean.
I can say that a rule has an exception.
